title: Bosun Trice Task Contract v1
description: Machine-readable schema contract for a standalone Trice (Realm 2: Tasks & GTD) task note's YAML frontmatter. Governs the entity-level task file; inline `- [ ]` bracket task lines inside any note body are parsed separately by the Trice task-line AST and are not required to satisfy this contract.

schema.description: Frontmatter type tag identifying this entity as a Trice task, schema version 1.

id.description: Stable task identifier (ULID/UUID), independent of file path.

state.description: Task lifecycle state. Mirrors the strict bracket markers: pending=' ', active='/', done='x', dropped='-', blocked='!'.

project.description: Identifier of the owning `$trice:project/v1` entity, if any.

scheduled.description: Scheduled start date, ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tags.description: User tags associated with the task.

blocked_by.description: Identifiers of other tasks that must complete before this one may proceed (used with state='blocked').
